answer: A gale of fake accounts then costs real capital per node, while honest actors recover bonds on exit. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, slashed if peers detect duplicate identities. The tundra of low-stake throwaways becomes unprofitable, and the fable of free reputation collapses because every vote carries skin in the game. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
